blurb: Buffalo Bike Tours offers guided history, food, waterfront, and Niagara Falls bike tours, as well as bike and e-bike rentals. Tours explore Buffalo's architecture, history, food scene, and scenic waterfronts. Rentals include road bikes and e-bikes with safety gear and maps.
extraNote: Cancel more than 48 hours ahead for full refund; otherwise sales are final · Tours run rain or shine except for extreme weather like lightning or high winds · Arrive 15 minutes early; late arrivals cannot be accommodated on that tour · Minimum 4 people needed to run a tour; options to reschedule or refund if not met · Buffalo tours depart from Buffalo Bike Tours at 44 Prime St, Canalside, across from Tim Horton's in 2 blue shipping containers. Niagara tours depart from Aquarium of Niagara parking lot, 701 Whirlpool Street. · Summer season, daily tours
